manifest.name: Soft98 Pro
manifest.description: Soft98 Pro enhancements, ad blocking, anti-adblock patching, and download recovery.

runtime.moveControl: Drag to move. Alt+Arrow keys also move this control.

runtime.tauntText: The page kept its software. The advertising campaign lost the boarding pass.
runtime.successLog: The page kept its content. The ads did not. Challenge accepted with clean instruments.

options.headline: Precise page control without fragile names.
options.body: Patch packed Soft98 code, preserve download links, remove ads and noisy blocker-side notices, then optionally tune the Soft98 Pro experience.
options.updateCurrent: You have the latest GitHub release.
options.updateAvailable: Version {version} is available on GitHub Releases.
options.updateFailed: The release check could not be completed. Your installed protection remains active.

blockAds: Remove ad surfaces using source, shape, and link behavior.
patchScripts: Unpack and patch Soft98 anti-adblock code before it runs.
darkDesign: Apply the modern dark Soft98 Pro theme.
pirateLogo: Use the bundled pirate logo after successful cleanup.
taunt: Show the optional success note only after cleanup succeeds.
diagnostics: Expose useful logs and interactive page APIs.
